We were looking for yummy restaurants in the South Bay and came across a Reddit post mentioning Hunan Impression as one of the top eats in SJ. We came by 30 minutes before closing and got seated right away. We ordered the fish fillet in chili oil and shredded potatoes- the fish had so much favor but I wish the potatoes had more spice! I am looking to try mapo tofu and spicy fish pot next.
